name: kimi
title_zh: 设计稿交给它，前端代码拿回来就能跑
tagline_zh: 本地 Kimi Code CLI 的非交互封装，专治视觉方向、设计系统、界面评审和前端打磨。能看本地图和视频。
tagline_en: A non-interactive wrapper for the local Kimi Code CLI, strong at visual direction, design systems, UI critique.
desc_en: Delegate design-heavy UI/UX work, frontend implementation, coding, repository exploration, review, and media-aware analysis to the local Kimi Code CLI through a bundled non-interactive wrapper. Kimi is a design-strong Agent suited to visual direction, design systems, interface critique, and frontend polish. It can inspect local images and videos but cannot generate or edit image assets. Invoke onl
why_zh: 把 Kimi 的设计判断力直接接进你的工作流，不用开 IDE、不用陪聊。它懂界面好坏，能审仓库。
why_en: Bridges Kimi's design judgment straight into your pipeline—no IDE, no chit-chat. It critiques UI, explores repos, and writes.
limit_zh: 只认 Kimi Code CLI 且需预先登录；不能生成或编辑图片素材，只能分析已有的本地图和视频。
limit_en: Requires pre-authenticated Kimi Code CLI; cannot generate or edit image assets, only analyze existing local ones; non-interactive—no follow-up.
title_en: Hand it the design, get back runnable frontend code
